meta.purpose: Define auditable evidence records generated from each analysed question before updating student mastery.

gating_rules: needs_review evidence cannot create confirmed or persistent weakness
provisional evidence may affect trend softly but cannot close or reopen mastery by itself
human_verified evidence receives priority over unverified model output
OCR confidence, curriculum mapping confidence and error-cause confidence are separate and must never be collapsed into one hidden score
a correct answer may provide positive mastery evidence when the item genuinely tests the mapped skill
partial marks should create component-level evidence where possible instead of binary right/wrong evidence
auditability: Every diagnostic statement shown to teacher/student must be traceable to one or more evidence_record IDs and source image regions.
